# Brand in config

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

Rule brand.no-env-colours (warn only). The app's brand (its name, colours and logo) is a committed config/brand.php, not KIT_BRAND_* env keys: env keeps only secrets and per-environment values. `php artisan kit:brand:migrate` writes config/brand.php from the env keys. The rule becomes an error in the tey/kit 0.16 era.

No generator yet; follow the summary and stamp the file `standards-pattern: ui-page.brand-config`.

Kit: none.
Checks: brand.no-env-colours. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Conventions:
- The brand lives in config/brand.php as committed values. Neither config/brand.php nor config/kit.php reads it with env('KIT_BRAND_…').
- .env.example and every committed .env.* file carry no KIT_BRAND_* keys; .env itself is never committed and is not read.
- To move an app: run `php artisan kit:brand:migrate`, commit config/brand.php, then delete the KIT_BRAND_* lines from the env files.
- Warn only until the tey/kit 0.16 era, when the rule becomes an error.

Related: `ui-page.styling`.

Graduates: To a ready leaf, and the rule to an error, in the tey/kit 0.16 era, once kit:brand:migrate has shipped and the apps have moved.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Styling, or page layout?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.brand-config` to see its siblings.
